method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation whose last amendment in operation is the Transfer of Land Amendment Act 2022 Pt 3 Div 1 (7 August 2023); ss 224-226 and 253 uncommenced; legislation.wa.gov.au mrdoc_46400, retrieved 7 September 2026. With the Community Titles Regulations 2021, version 00-r0-00, in currency from 1 July 2026, mrdoc_49620, retrieved 20 October 2026 (regs 8, 59, 60, 77-79, 84, 173 and Schedule 1).

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: s 3(1) (notifiable variations, working day), ss 16(6)-(7), 17(6)-(8), 41(1), 43(1)-(2), 44(1)-(2), 46(5), 47, 48(1)-(2), (5)-(8), 70, 71, 72(2), 85(1)-(2), 87(5)-(6), 88(1)(e)-(g), (2)-(6), 94(2)-(4), 97(2)-(3), 106(3), (5)-(8), (13)(c), (14)(b), 107(5), 130(3)-(4), 131(3)-(4), 132-137, 138(2), 162(1)(a), (f), (h), (3), 175(1)-(2); out: planning and the community development statement, scheme documents and registration, statutory easements, rates, the original subdivision owner's own duties, insurance, property powers, records, meetings, councils, scheme managers, termination, the Tribunal's orders in detail, machinery
seat: the owner of a lot in a community titles scheme (and, before settlement, the buyer about to become one)
